principle: Bricely may TRIGGER existing reversible/internal features only — never new autonomous code to perform actions. Irreversible/customer-facing = human-gated permanently.
inherits: DR-CS-PLATFORM-006 kill switch / serial / live log
bug-change-classification does not invent features — Lane 2 is invoke-only

proposed_allowlist.what_bricely_does: Calls existing applyDisplayNameLiveFix / host onLiveFix — writes sessionStorage greeting override only
proposed_allowlist.reversibility: Clear sessionStorage key wmg.portal.greeting.v1:* or New chat / sign-out session end; does not mutate CRM primary_contact_name
proposed_allowlist.notes: Already partially wired in Phase 1 smoke; ratification makes it an official Lane 2 allowlist row

proposed_allowlist.what_bricely_does: Instructs or programmatically switches the signed-in user's UI to an existing screen they can already access (home, load-board, statements) — no new routes
proposed_allowlist.reversibility: User navigates back; session screen key overwritable
proposed_allowlist.guard: Must respect canAccessView / portal accounting gates — never open a screen the role cannot access

proposed_allowlist.locus: LoadBoardKanban localStorage wmg.loadBoard.viewMode; board search/filter React state
proposed_allowlist.what_bricely_does: Resets view mode / clears client-side filters to defaults (soft tip already says clear filter)
Starts fresh support thread; queues prior transcript to history
proposed_allowlist.reversibility: History retained in session/server thread store; no ERP write

proposed_allowlist.what_bricely_does: Triggers existing refresh of board rows (GET/RPC read path already used by UI)
proposed_allowlist.reversibility: Read-only; no state mutation beyond client cache
proposed_allowlist.guard: Invoke only existing read RPCs; never allocate/update-load

proposed_allowlist.locus: Browser clipboard from values already on screen (REL#, memo #)
proposed_allowlist.what_bricely_does: Copies a reference the user can already see into clipboard for their own paste
Expands in-portal 'How to use' guide already in UI

proposed_allowlist.locus: supabase function ai-draft-customer-email ONLY (confirmed: no SendGrid/send in that function)
proposed_allowlist.what_bricely_does: INTERNAL operators only: invoke ONLY the existing ai-draft-customer-email function (or equivalent draft API). Return draft subject/body into Bricely chat or a draft-only buffer for human review. ZERO send path.
proposed_allowlist.reversibility: Draft text discarded if unused; no mail leaves the system via SF8
proposed_allowlist.guard: HARD: SF8 must NEVER call send-customer-email, notify-*, open EmailDrawer Send, click Send Email, or any outbound delivery route. Draft compose/prepare only. Buyer/seller surfaces: SF8 off.

sf8_confirmation.prior_wording_risk: left draft in EmailDrawer which also has Send Email button — tightened to draft-API-only, no send UI automation
sf8_confirmation.tightened_to: compose/prepare only; zero ability to send/notify/deliver

explicitly_excluded_never_autonomous.why: Changes ERP load state / money-adjacent workflow
Auth / access — irreversible from customer view; security-sensitive
examples: password reset email to another user

explicitly_excluded_never_autonomous.why: Lane 2 is invoke-existing only — writing new automation to 'be helpful' is out of scope
examples: Script that emails sellers in bulk

worked_examples.ask: Change my home welcome to Dave
worked_examples.verdict: Candidate after ratification — session greeting override only
Candidate — navigate to statements if role allows + explain
Candidate — clear local filters / reset viewMode

worked_examples.ask: Email the buyer the sales memo
worked_examples.verdict: NEVER autonomous — human sends via EmailDrawer

worked_examples.ask: Assign this load to Toronto Textile
worked_examples.verdict: NEVER autonomous — allocate-load is ERP write

worked_examples.ask: Submit my payment notice for me
Invite our AP clerk to the portal
Draft an email to the seller about pickup
worked_examples.verdict: Only if ratified AND internal operator surface AND draft-only; send remains human. If unsure → escalate

mapping_from_resolution_tiers_tier_a.password_reset: HUMAN for other-user resets (NX4); self-serve guidance-only remains Tier A talk-track, not autonomous email send
mapping_from_resolution_tiers_tier_a.login_help: Guidance + SF2 navigation; no auth writes
mapping_from_resolution_tiers_tier_a.known_issue_canned: Talk-track only unless paired with SF3/SF4
mapping_from_resolution_tiers_tier_a.read_only_data_lookup: SF5 read refresh only — no new queries inventing PII dumps

execution_rules_when_enabled_later: Bricely may only call listed feature ids; anything else escalates
Log every trigger to executions/live-log.jsonl + ticket note
Kill switch halt stops Lane 2 triggers
Buyer/seller surfaces: SF8 disabled even if ratified for internal
